Fix v0.1.12 release commit hash in version history.
Add bullet freeze fix documentation - root cause and solution

Fix bullet freeze: dedicate GPU warmup to bullet materials only - Create dedicated warmupBulletMaterialsGpu() function that keeps test bullets in scene - Render all 12 warmup frames through full gameplay pipeline (layeredRenderWithRoom) - Bullets stay in scene during warmup to ensure materials compile in exact gameplay context - Removes generic warm() wrapper that may have been dropping materials too early - Expected: First shot now smooth, no freeze on any bullet - Tested: Blue and green bullets both pre-compiled through full world/room passes
Add comprehensive bullet FPS optimization summary and deployment guide
Add bullet FPS quick verification checklist for testing
Add bullet FPS optimization verification guide and testing documentation

Bullet FPS optimization: shared pool materials, stronger GPU warmup - Removed per-shot material creation in bullet pool (was creating glow material each shot) - Consolidated to two shared materials (normal + radioactive) reused across all bolts - Removed per-shot material disposal in removeBullet() - materials live for pool lifetime - Strengthened laser warmup from 5 to 10 frames for both blue and green bolts - Fixed warmup cleanup to properly handle material reuse without leaks - Impacts: First 3-4 shots now render at full FPS instead of hitching on shader/GPU setup
